scripts.postinstall: npm run build -w @business-manager/contracts && npm run prisma:generate -w @business-manager/api
scripts.dev: concurrently --names api,web --prefix-colors blue,green "npm run dev -w @business-manager/api" "npm run dev -w @business-manager/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @business-manager/contracts && npm run build -w @business-manager/api && npm run build -w @business-manager/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @business-manager/contracts && npm run typecheck -w @business-manager/api && npm run typecheck -w @business-manager/web
